findings.body: Changing `use openhuman_core::openhuman as oh` to `use openhuman_core as oh` repoints every `oh::` reference from `openhuman_core::openhuman::*` to `openhuman_core::*`. The visible usage on line 37, `oh::mcp::http_client::{...}`, now resolves to `openhuman_core::mcp::http_client` instead of `openhuman_core::openhuman::mcp::http_client`. If `mcp` lives under the `openhuman` submodule rather than at the crate root, or if any other `oh::` references in the file (not shown in the diff) depended on the submodule path, this will fail to compile. I was unable to read the full file or search for the module definition to confirm which path is correct.
findings.title: Verify oh::mcp::http_client resolves under the crate root after repointing the alias

value.summary: The change repoints the `oh` alias from the `openhuman_core::openhuman` submodule to the `openhuman_core` crate root. This is only safe if every `oh::` reference in the file (at minimum the visible `oh::mcp::http_client` on line 37) resolves identically under the new path. I could not read the full file or verify the module layout, so I cannot confirm the change compiles.
